title: Continuous watch-ratio and anchored same-session margin consensus
hypothesis: Continuous watch-ratio supervision can improve global preference calibration while a lightly weighted same-session margin can independently sharpen top-ranked separation without replacing the pointwise objective.

watch_ratio_candidate.model: full-history DeepFM with continuous auxiliary regression head

session_margin_candidate.model: full-history DeepFM with pointwise-anchored same-session margin

acceptance: Promote only when the fixed official-validation score improves, both disjoint-user folds improve, and no validation outcome is used as a feature or training target.
